medicines.name: Paracetamol
medicines.use: Reduces fever and relieves mild to moderate pain like headache, body ache, toothache
medicines.side_effects: Very safe at normal doses. Avoid alcohol. Do not exceed 4g/day.
medicines.simple_explanation: This medicine brings down your fever and reduces pain. It is one of the safest medicines available.

medicines.name: Amoxicillin
medicines.use: Antibiotic that kills bacteria causing throat, ear, chest, urinary tract and skin infections
medicines.side_effects: May cause nausea, diarrhea, or allergic rash. Tell doctor if allergic to penicillin.
medicines.simple_explanation: This is an antibiotic that kills the bacteria making you sick. Always complete the full course even if you feel better — stopping early can make bacteria resistant.

medicines.name: Levocetirizine
medicines.use: Antihistamine that relieves allergy symptoms — runny nose, sneezing, itchy eyes, skin rashes and hives
medicines.side_effects: May cause drowsiness. Avoid driving. Do not drink alcohol.
medicines.simple_explanation: This medicine stops your body's allergic reaction — it will reduce your runny nose, sneezing and itchy eyes. Best taken at night as it can make you sleepy.

medicines.name: Ambrodil
medicines.use: Expectorant and mucolytic — thins and loosens mucus in the airways making it easier to cough out
medicines.side_effects: May cause mild nausea or stomach upset. Drink plenty of water.
medicines.simple_explanation: This syrup loosens the thick mucus stuck in your chest and throat, making it easier to cough it out. Drink warm water alongside for best results.

medicines.name: Pantoprazole
medicines.use: Proton pump inhibitor — reduces excess stomach acid, treats acidity, GERD, ulcers and protects stomach lining when taking other medicines
medicines.side_effects: Generally well tolerated. May cause headache or diarrhea rarely.
medicines.simple_explanation: This medicine reduces the acid your stomach produces. It protects your stomach from the other medicines you are taking and relieves acidity or heartburn.

medicines.name: Azithromycin
medicines.use: Antibiotic for respiratory infections, throat infections, typhoid, and skin infections
medicines.side_effects: May cause nausea, stomach pain, or diarrhea. Take with food.
medicines.simple_explanation: This is a powerful antibiotic taken once daily. It stays active in your body for days so even a short course works. Complete all tablets given.

medicines.name: Cetirizine
medicines.use: Antihistamine for allergy symptoms — runny nose, sneezing, hives, itching
medicines.side_effects: Can cause drowsiness. Avoid driving. Do not drink alcohol.
medicines.simple_explanation: This allergy medicine reduces sneezing, runny nose, and itching caused by dust, pollen or other allergens. Take at night to avoid daytime sleepiness.

medicines.name: Metformin
medicines.use: Controls blood sugar levels in Type 2 diabetes by reducing glucose production in the liver
medicines.side_effects: May cause stomach upset initially. Always take with food. Never skip meals.
medicines.simple_explanation: This medicine controls your blood sugar. Take it with your meals every day without fail. Never stop it on your own — blood sugar can spike dangerously.

medicines.name: Amlodipine
medicines.use: Calcium channel blocker that relaxes blood vessels and lowers blood pressure and treats chest pain
medicines.side_effects: May cause ankle swelling, flushing or dizziness when standing up quickly.
medicines.simple_explanation: This medicine relaxes your blood vessels to lower blood pressure. Take it at the same time every day. Do not stop suddenly — always consult your doctor first.

medicines.name: Atorvastatin
medicines.use: Statin that lowers bad cholesterol (LDL) and reduces risk of heart attack and stroke
medicines.side_effects: Rarely causes muscle pain. Report any unexplained muscle aches to your doctor.
medicines.simple_explanation: This medicine lowers the bad cholesterol in your blood to protect your heart. Take it at night. Avoid grapefruit juice while on this medicine.

medicines.name: Omeprazole
medicines.use: Reduces stomach acid production, treats acidity, GERD, peptic ulcers
medicines.side_effects: Generally safe. Long-term use may affect magnesium or B12 levels.
medicines.simple_explanation: This capsule reduces the acid in your stomach. Take it 30 minutes before your first meal of the day. It relieves heartburn and acidity.

medicines.name: Ibuprofen
medicines.use: Anti-inflammatory painkiller for fever, headache, body ache, dental pain, menstrual cramps and joint pain
medicines.side_effects: Always take with food — can irritate the stomach. Avoid if you have kidney problems or ulcers.
medicines.simple_explanation: This medicine reduces pain, swelling and fever. Always take it after eating food to protect your stomach. Do not take on an empty stomach.

medicines.name: Cefixime
medicines.use: Antibiotic for urinary tract infections, throat infections, ear infections and typhoid
medicines.side_effects: May cause diarrhea, nausea or stomach pain. Complete the full course.
medicines.simple_explanation: This is a strong antibiotic tablet. Take it at regular intervals every day and complete all the tablets even if you feel better. Stopping early is dangerous.

medicines.name: Dolo
medicines.use: Reduces fever and relieves mild to moderate pain — same as paracetamol but higher dose
medicines.side_effects: Safe at normal doses. Do not take more than 4 tablets per day. Avoid alcohol.
medicines.simple_explanation: Dolo is paracetamol in a higher 650mg dose, commonly used for fever and body pain. Take it after food and drink plenty of water.

medicines.name: Montelukast
medicines.use: Prevents and treats asthma and seasonal allergies by blocking leukotrienes that cause inflammation
medicines.side_effects: May cause headache or stomach pain. Take at night.
medicines.simple_explanation: This tablet prevents asthma attacks and reduces allergy symptoms. Take it every night before bed. It works best when taken regularly even when you feel fine.

medicines.name: Vitamin D3
medicines.use: Treats and prevents Vitamin D deficiency, supports bone health, immunity and muscle function
medicines.side_effects: Very safe. Do not take more than prescribed — excess can cause calcium buildup.
medicines.simple_explanation: This is a Vitamin D supplement to strengthen your bones and immunity. Take it with a fatty meal like milk or after lunch for best absorption.

medicines.name: Combiflam
medicines.use: Combination painkiller with ibuprofen and paracetamol for stronger pain and fever relief
medicines.side_effects: Always take with food. Avoid if you have acidity, kidney problems or ulcers.
medicines.simple_explanation: This tablet combines two painkillers for stronger relief of fever, headache and body pain. Always take it after eating — never on an empty stomach.

medicines.name: Ranitidine
medicines.use: Reduces stomach acid for treating acidity, heartburn, ulcers and GERD
medicines.side_effects: Generally well tolerated. May cause headache or constipation rarely.
medicines.simple_explanation: This medicine reduces acid in your stomach and provides relief from heartburn and acidity. Take it before meals for best effect.
